title: A Trip to the Zoo
text:
Our school has thirty students. There are fifteen girls and fifteen boys. Our class is on the second floor. We have forty books in the library.

Today we go on a trip to the zoo. The zoo has fifty animals and one hundred birds. The bus leaves at eight o'clock. Each ticket costs twenty dollars.

questions.text: How many students are in the school?
How many animals are in the zoo?
What can we infer about the trip?
options: It will probably be a full day trip
It will be a trip of one minute
It will take a whole week

questions.text: How much would two tickets probably cost?

vocabulary.definition: people who study at a school
living creatures such as dogs, lions or birds
a small paper or card that allows you to enter a place

paragraph_translations: Nuestra escuela tiene treinta estudiantes. Hay quince niñas y quince niños. Nuestra clase está en el segundo piso. Tenemos cuarenta libros en la biblioteca.
Hoy vamos de viaje al zoológico. El zoológico tiene cincuenta animales y cien pájaros. El autobús sale a las ocho en punto. Cada boleto cuesta veinte dólares.
